text: この　ジムに　きた　から　には　そういう　ポケモンの　おく　ふかさ　タップリ　おしえて　やる！

structure.jp: この　ジムに　きた　から　には
structure.en: now that you've come to this Gym

structure.jp: そういう　ポケモンの　おく　ふかさ
structure.en: that kind of depth Pokémon has

structure.jp: タップリ　おしえて　やる！

patterns.name: 〜からには
patterns.span: きた　から　には
patterns.explanation: からには after a verb means 'now that this is so', and what follows is what naturally has to happen. きた　から　には = 'now that you've come'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb means doing something for someone you talk down to; it can sound like a threat. おしえて　やる = 'I'll teach you'.
